channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Gleisi: rejeição a Messias é oportunidade para debater indicação de mulher ao STF
item.description: Federal deputy Gleisi Hoffmann (PT-PR) stated that the rejection of Jorge Messias's nomination to the Supreme Federal Court (STF) presents an opportunity to appoint a woman to the Court. She argued that the selection should reflect gender diversity and representativeness in the Judiciary.

item.title: Fantasma de 'Lula encastelado' volta a rondar Planalto após 'não' a Messias
item.description: The Senate's rejection of Jorge Messias' nomination to the Supreme Court renewed criticism of President Lula for his allegedly 'entrenched' posture, causing discomfort within the Palácio do Planalto. The decision was interpreted as a sign of political fragility and government isolation from Congress.

item.title: Michelle Bolsonaro comemora rejeição de Messias no Senado: 'Justiça de Deus foi feita'
item.description: Michelle Bolsonaro celebrated the Senate's rejection of Jorge Messias' nomination to the Supreme Federal Court, stating that 'God's justice was done'. She shared a post from Senator Marcio Bittar (PL-AC) on social media, highlighting the vote outcome as a victory.

item.title: Congresso derruba veto de Lula a projeto de lei da dosimetria e beneficia Bolsonaro
item.description: Congress overturned President Lula's veto on the Dosimetry Bill, which reduces sentences for those convicted of attempted coup d'état. The move directly benefits allies of former President Jair Bolsonaro, including those implicated in the January 8 attacks.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro rebate críticas do PT e Psol: “Mais amor, gente”
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL), a pre-candidate for president in 2026, rebutted criticisms from PT and Psol lawmakers during a joint congressional session, urging 'more love' and less hatred in Brazil. He stated he would govern for all Brazilians, including those who insult him with lies and slander, and pledged to 'embrace and care' for the population regardless of political affiliation.

item.title: La oposición a Lula aprueba en el Congreso reducir la condena de Bolsonaro por golpista
item.description: Brazil's Congress passed a law to significantly reduce prison sentences for Jair Bolsonaro and others convicted of attempting a coup. The bill, previously vetoed by President Lula da Silva as unconstitutional and a dangerous signal of impunity, was revived and approved by lawmakers. The move has sparked controversy for benefiting figures aligned with Bolsonarism.

item.title: Lula faz pronunciamento às vésperas do Dia do Trabalho
item.description: Lula will deliver his second national address of 2026 on the eve of Workers' Day, focusing on ending the 6x1 work scale as a government priority. The speech comes after the Senate's rejection of Jorge Messias for the Supreme Court, marking one of the biggest political defeats of his third term. Lula aims to strengthen his appeal among female voters by emphasizing the fight against gender-based violence as a central pillar of his re-election campaign.

item.title: Palavra final sobre PL da Dosimetria pode ser do Supremo; entenda próximos passos
item.description: The Dosimetria Bill, which reduces sentences for those convicted of the January 8 acts, was struck down by Congress but may be challenged in the STF by the government, which has previously signaled opposition to broad amnesties. The move comes amid escalating tensions between branches of government, following the Senate’s historic rejection — the first in over 130 years — of Lula’s STF nominee. Bolsonarists see the bill as a stepping stone toward full amnesty, while the STF, including Justice Alexandre de Moraes, warns it sends a dangerous signal of tolerance for democratic attacks.

item.title: Palanque de Lula em Minas fica em xeque após Rodrigo Pacheco evitar declarar voto em Messias
item.description: The defeat of Jorge Messias in the STF triggered a political crisis threatening Lula's electoral strategy in Minas Gerais, as allies now question the loyalty of Rodrigo Pacheco, the government's potential gubernatorial candidate, despite his public support for Messias. The secret vote exposed government articulation failures and raised doubts about Pacheco's awareness of Davi Alcolumbre's alleged opposition, which intensified after Pacheco's meeting with Messias, even as he appeared publicly allied with the nominee.

item.title: STF desfalcado poderia ser desculpa perfeita para Lula fazer nova indicação, avaliam aliados
item.description: Allies of President Lula believe that the retirement of Luís Roberto Barroso last year, leaving the Supreme Court with only 10 members, could be the perfect excuse for a new nomination. Despite the Senate's rejection of Jorge Messias, allies are divided: some urge an early nomination to assert presidential prerogative, while others advise caution to avoid provoking a confrontation with Congress.

item.title: PL da Dosimetria: veja como votaram os deputados e senadores para derrubar o veto de Lula
item.description: Congress overturned President Lula's veto on the Dosimetry Bill, with 318 deputies and 49 senators voting to override. The bill may reduce sentences for those convicted of attempting a coup after the 2022 election, though reduction is not automatic and requires judicial review. The PT has announced it will challenge the decision in court.

item.title: Ao vivo: Lula anuncia crédito para compra de caminhões e ônibus
item.description: The federal government launched the second phase of the Move Brasil program, aimed at financing trucks and buses, after the exhaustion of R$10 billion in the first phase. The announcement on April 30, 2026, came amid political setbacks, including the Senate's rejection of Jorge Messias for the STF and the overturning of a presidential veto to reduce Jair Bolsonaro's sentence for coup attempt. The program, which had already contracted R$4.2 billion in phase one, offers up to R$50 million per beneficiary, with repayment terms of up to 60 months and interest rates between 13% and 14% annually.

item.title: Agora vai?
item.description: The proposal to abolish the 6×1 work scale and reduce the weekly workweek from 44 to 40 hours is advancing in the Chamber of Deputies, with two Constitutional Amendment Proposals (PECs) approved in the CCJ and an urgent government bill from Lula’s administration. Despite employer resistance, labor movements view this as a historic chance to reverse the setbacks of the 2017 labor reform, with a vote expected by end of May.

item.title: Messias agradece Mendonça por apoio após derrota no Senado
item.description: Union Attorney General Jorge Messias thanked Supreme Court Minister André Mendonça for his support after the Senate rejected his nomination to the Court on April 30, 2026, by a vote of 42 to 34. Messias praised Mendonça’s integrity and inspiration, stating the setback does not end his public career. He affirmed he will continue to serve in the country’s institutional life.

item.title: Congresso impõe nova derrota ao governo e derruba veto à dosimetria
item.description: Congress overturned the presidential veto on the dosimetry bill, which reduces sentences for those convicted of the January 8 anti-democratic acts, including former President Jair Bolsonaro, whose sentence could be reduced by 2 years and 5 months to 3 years. The vote came a day after the Senate rejected Jorge Messias’ nomination to the Supreme Court, marking another setback for President Lula. The bill amends the Penal Execution Law and Penal Code, also benefiting core figures in the coup plot.

item.title: Desvirtuamento político contaminou rejeição de Messias
item.description: The Senate rejected Jorge Messias's nomination as Attorney General of the Union for the STF, with 42 votes against and 34 in favor, breaking a tradition of smooth approvals since the late 19th century. Although constitutionally legitimate, the decision reflects growing politicization in a process that should be guided by technical criteria such as legal expertise and impeccable reputation.

item.title: Varejo faz ato em defesa da “taxa das blusinhas” em Brasília
item.description: Retail, industry, and union representatives protested in Brasília in defense of the 'blusinhas tax,' which applies a 20% import tax on goods under US$50, arguing its removal would create unfair competition against domestic businesses. The Prospera Brazil Coalition and ABVTex stated the policy generated 860,000 jobs in commerce and 578,000 in industry since 2023, along with wage and income growth. The demonstration follows Lula’s April 14 comment that taxing low-value international purchases is unnecessary.

item.title: Após derrota, PT planeja ir ao STF contra projeto da dosimetria
item.description: Following the congressional override of President Lula's veto on the dosimetry bill, the PT plans to file a lawsuit at the STF, citing unconstitutionality and procedural flaws, particularly the inclusion of a Sergio Moro amendment in the Senate without returning the bill to the Chamber. The law reduces sentences for those convicted in the January 8 attacks and may benefit Jair Bolsonaro. PT leader Pedro Uczai stated the judicial move is independent of the government and based on legal arguments.

item.title: “Te vejo nos debates”, diz Renan a Flávio após provocação sobre cogumelos
item.description: Renan Santos, president of Missão, responded to a provocation by Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ), who had mocked him with an emoji and a comment about 'mushrooms' in a video. Renan replied, 'I'll see you in the debates,' signaling his willingness to confront him publicly. The exchange followed Flávio's suggestion that Renan had tried to accuse him and 'failed'.

item.title: Messias posta versículo um dia após indicação ao STF ser rejeitada: 'Não tenho medo de dez mil inimigos'
item.description: One day after the Senate rejected his nomination to the Supreme Federal Court (STF), Attorney General Jorge Messias posted a biblical verse from Psalm 3 on social media, stating he fears no 'ten thousand enemies'. Senator Eliziane Gama praised his resilience, while lawmakers like Gleisi Hoffmann and Fabiano Comparato lamented the decision, emphasizing his qualifications and the negative impact on democracy and judicial integrity.

item.title: Messias agradece apoio de Mendonça e Gilmar após ser rejeitado para vaga ao STF
item.description: Jorge Messias, head of the AGU, publicly thanked Ministers André Mendonça and Gilmar Mendes for their support after being rejected by senators for a Supreme Court seat, losing 42-34. Mendonça, an evangelical like Messias, mobilized opposition senators in his favor, while Gilmar, who had initially backed Rodrigo Pacheco, shifted to defend Messias following Lula’s nomination.

item.title: PL da Dosimetria pode colocar ex-presidente Bolsonaro nas ruas antes da eleição de 2030
item.description: The overturning of President Lula's veto on the Dosimetria Bill could reduce Jair Bolsonaro's sentence, allowing him to progress to semi-open regime in about two years. Although this would grant him daytime access to the streets, he remains ineligible due to his criminal conviction and two electoral ineligibilities, blocking his 2030 candidacy. The government may still challenge the bill in the STF, and any benefit would require a ruling by Minister Alexandre de Moraes.

item.title: Lula não tem mais força, diz Tarcísio sobre rejeição a Messias
item.description: São Paulo Governor Tarcísio de Freitas (Republicanos) stated that the rejection of Jorge Messias, Lula’s nominee to the Supreme Federal Court, reveals the federal government’s fragility. He argued this shows President Lula no longer has the political strength to secure approval for key appointments.

item.title: Ligações de Shakira com Brasil
item.description: Shakira has maintained a over-30-year connection with Brazil, marked by appearances on TV shows such as Hebe Camargo, Planeta Xuxa, and Caldeirão do Huck, as well as collaborations with Brazilian artists like Xuxa, Rouge, Ivete Sangalo, and Anitta. She has performed in smaller cities with affordable tickets, such as a R$5 show in Uberlândia in 1997, and was received by former President Dilma Rousseff in 2011, to whom she gifted an autographed guitar.

item.title: O que diz Flávio Bolsonaro sobre os atritos na direita com Michelle Bolsonaro
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro stated that Michelle Bolsonaro is aligned with his political project and downplayed recent tensions within the right, asserting that disagreements are normal and do not signal a rupture. He emphasized the need for unity in the 2026 presidential race and confirmed that all allies will publicly support his pre-candidacy.

item.title: Moraes e Alcolumbre provaram que Lula perdeu governabilidade e virou refém
item.description: Minister Alexandre de Moraes and Senate President Davi Alcolumbre joined forces to show that President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva has lost governability, following the defeat in appointing Jorge Messias to the STF and the partial overturn of the veto on the dosimetry bill. This alliance reflects dissatisfaction with the Master case and a legislative push for greater influence in judicial appointments, weakening Lula’s position and fueling internal government tensions.

item.title: TSE cassa mandato do governador e determina eleições diretas em Roraima
item.description: The Superior Electoral Court (TSE) annulled the mandate of Roraima's governor, Edilson Damião (União Brasil), and ordered direct elections for the position. The plenary also upheld the eight-year ineligibility of former governor Antonio Denarium (Republicanos) for abuse of political and economic power in the 2022 elections. The ruling takes immediate effect, removing the governor from office and requiring a new election within 20 to 40 days, unless technical infeasibility is proven by the state's electoral court (TRE-RR).

item.title: Renan Calheiros nega traição a Lula e diz ter votado por Messias no STF: 'Derrotas não devem gerar efeitos lisérgicos'
item.description: Senator Renan Calheiros (MDB) denied betraying the Lula government by voting against Jorge Messias' STF nomination, stating he worked and voted in favor of the AGU. He dismissed allegations as 'false' and said defeats should teach, not cause 'psychedelic effects'. Messias received 34 yes votes and 42 no votes, falling short of the 41 needed for approval.

item.title: Plenário mantém cassação de deputada do Amapá por uso irregular de recursos
item.description: The Plenary of the Superior Electoral Court (TSE) unanimously upheld the removal of former federal deputy Silvia Waiãpi (PL-AP) for illegally using public campaign funds. She spent R$9,000 on a facial harmonization procedure, falsified an invoice to conceal the expense, and obstructed Electoral Justice oversight, constituting an electoral crime under Article 30-A of the Elections Law.

item.title: 8 em cada 10 eleitores têm imagem negativa de Alcolumbre, diz AtlasIntel
item.description: An AtlasIntel poll shows 81% of voters have a negative image of Davi Alcolumbre (União-AP), Senate president, with only 3% positive. Worse than him is only House Speaker Hugo Motta (Republicanos-PB), with 87% negative and 2% positive. Lula and Bolsonaro tie at 45% positive and 53% negative.

item.title: É #FAKE foto de Jorge Messias chorando em carro após rejeição no Senado; trata-se de montagem
item.description: The photo circulating on social media showing Jorge Messias crying in a car after his STF nomination was rejected by the Senate is fake. It is a manipulated version of a real image taken by photojournalist Kebec Nogueira of Metrópoles, in which Messias shows no signs of crying, leaving the Alvorada Palace with his wife.

item.title: Oposição usou Messias como bode expiatório para antecipar eleição, diz Randolfe
item.description: Senator Randolfe Rodrigues (PT-AP) accused the opposition of using Attorney General Jorge Messias as a scapegoat to anticipate the October elections, rejecting his STF nomination not on technical grounds but for electoral motives. He stated the Senate vote was driven by the electoral process, not Messias’ qualifications or reputation, even though the government anticipated the difficulty of approval.

item.title: PT faz oficina para militantes e pede a aliados que falem bem de Lula para amigos
item.description: The PT held a digital militants workshop aimed at Lula’s re-election, urging supporters to act as his ‘voice’ by sharing positive messages with friends and family about his achievements. Participants were asked to send personal messages and record simple videos about ongoing federal projects. The Perseu Abramo Foundation also announced an online course in May on security, citizenship, and democracy, with the inaugural lecture addressing the challenges of Latin American left-wing politics.

item.title: Ao vivo: STF retoma julgamento sobre desoneração da folha
item.description: The Supreme Federal Court (STF) resumed judgment on a case challenging the 2023 law extending payroll tax exemptions for 17 economic sectors and municipalities. Relator Minister Cristiano Zanin voted to annul the law due to lack of budgetary compensation, supported by Ministers Edson Fachin and Gilmar Mendes. Alexandre de Mayoes requested a view, pausing the proceedings, which will resume in physical plenary with expectation that the majority will follow Zanin’s vote.

item.title: ‘Abre um precedente bastante perigoso’, diz Humberto Costa sobre derrota do governo
item.description: Senator Humberto Costa criticized the rejection of Jorge Messias' nomination to the Supreme Federal Court, stating that the decision sets a dangerous precedent for the independence of powers and was politically motivated to weaken President Lula's government ahead of elections. He emphasized that the Constitution grants the president the authority to nominate ministers, with the Senate's role limited to assessing technical and ethical qualifications — which, in his view, Messias met. Despite the defeat, Costa dismissed the idea of a broad rupture in the governing coalition and urged caution in the next nomination, expressing confidence in the government's ability to recover.

item.title: Castro recorre ao TSE para tentar salvar candidatura ao Senado
item.description: Former Rio de Janeiro governor Cláudio Castro (PL) has filed a declaration of omission appeal with the TSE to overturn his 2030 ineligibility, stemming from a conviction for abuse of political and economic power related to the hiring of 27,600 temporary workers in 2022, allegedly used as electoral operatives. His defense argues that key arguments were not considered and that procedural irregularities, such as unequal time for the MP and defense to present arguments, prejudiced his case. Even if the TSE denies the appeal, Castro may take the case to the STF, though historical precedents suggest little chance of reversal, threatening his Senate aspirations for 2026.

item.title: Veto a Messias deixa três lições históricas para o País
item.description: The Senate's rejection of Jorge Messias' nomination to the STF marks a historic turning point: it is the first presidential nomination rejection since Floriano Peixoto, ending 130 years of automatic approval. This reflects the defeat of presidential patronage in judicial appointments and challenges the STF's activist judicial trend since 2019, signaling a check on the Court's institutional activism.

item.title: Luiz Marinho afirma que Senado se “apequenou”
item.description: Labor and Employment Minister Luiz Marinho criticized the Senate for rejecting Jorge Messias' nomination to the Supreme Federal Court, saying the Senate 'diminished itself' by focusing on issues favoring the right in the electoral race. He argued Brazil needs a 'great' and 'sovereign' Senate, praised Messias as a top-tier jurist, and expressed hope that the Senate will acknowledge its error and reverse the decision in the future.

item.title: Articulação política do governo entra em xeque e vira alvo de aliados após derrota histórica de Lula com rejeição a Messias
item.description: The political articulation of the Lula government came under fire from allies following its historic defeat in the Senate vote on Jorge Messias’ STF nomination, with critics citing poor mapping and underestimation of Davi Alcolumbre’s offensive. Jaques Wagner, Senate government leader, and José Guimarães, Minister of Institutional Relations, are blamed for inaccurate assessments and failing to act in time, despite evidence that Alcolumbre had predicted the eight-vote loss. Calls for Wagner’s removal have emerged, despite his close ties to Lula.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro diz que derrota de Lula ‘marca fim do governo’ e faz promessa sobre anistia
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro claims the rejection of Jorge Messias to the Supreme Court marks the end of Lula’s government, citing opposition coordination and congressional dissatisfaction with perceived Executive and Judiciary overreach. He criticizes the STF for creating a 'court of cronies' and reaffirms amnesty for January 8 participants as a priority, positioning himself as a more moderate alternative to Jair Bolsonaro.

item.title: Gilmar Mendes defende Jorge Messias após rejeição no Senado
item.description: Supreme Court Justice Gilmar Mendes publicly defended Attorney General Jorge Messias after the Senate rejected his nomination to the Court, praising his career marked by courage, dignity, and humility. Mendes emphasized that the Senate legitimately exercised its constitutional prerogative and that the decision must be respected, despite calling Messias one of Brazil's greatest recent jurists. The nomination was rejected by 42 votes against, 34 in favor, and one abstention — the first rejection of an STF nominee since democratization.

item.title: ‘Cada indicação é uma indicação e o capítulo de ontem já foi encerrado’, diz líder do governo
item.description: Government leader in Congress Randolfe Rodrigues downplayed the Senate defeat of Jorge Messias, stating that each vote and nomination is independent and that the matter is closed. He said the government is now focusing on other issues, such as the veto on the Dosimetry Bill, and will assess the appropriate timing for future nominations, including potential ones for the Central Bank. Lula’s allies advise waiting for tensions between the branches to ease to avoid further legislative setbacks.

item.title: TSE determina eleição direta para mandato tampão em RR após cassar governador
item.description: The TSE ruled that Roraima must hold a direct election to fill the governor's position in a temporary mandate after removing Edilson Damião and declaring Antonio Denarium ineligible due to abuse of political and economic power in the 2022 elections. The decision follows electoral law, as the vacancy occurred more than six months before the end of the term. The Roraima Electoral Justice must be notified immediately, with potential election dates set for June 21, November 8, or December 6, 2026.

item.title: Michelle celebra derrota de Messias: “Justiça de Deus foi feita”
item.description: Former First Lady Michelle Bolsonaro celebrated the Senate's rejection of Jorge Messias' nomination to the Supreme Federal Court, stating 'God's justice was done'. The vote resulted in 42 against and 34 in favor, falling short of the required 41 affirmative votes. This marks the first rejection of a presidential Supreme Court nomination in 132 years, since 1894.

item.title: ‘A gente não vai desistir’, diz Flávio Bolsonaro ao defender anistia ampla após eleições
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro stated he will work for the approval of a broad amnesty bill after the 2026 elections, calling the veto on the Dosimetria bill insufficient. He said the measure aims to pardon those convicted for the January 8 events, reverse what he views as injustices, and 'reset the game' for hundreds of families, criticizing the Judiciary for alleged excesses and disregard for legal guarantees.

item.title: Lula fará pronunciamento na TV após derrota de Messias e na véspera do 1º de Maio
item.description: President Lula will deliver a national broadcast on Thursday, April 30, at 8:30 PM, following the historic rejection of Jorge Messias’ nomination to the STF and on the eve of May Day. The speech, coming before Labor Day, is expected to emphasize his agenda to end the 6×1 workweek — a key political asset for his 2026 re-election bid. Flávio Bolsonaro’s PL party has urged the TSE to enforce institutional neutrality in the address, fearing improper electoral use.

item.title: Alcolumbre retoma laço com bolsonarismo em rejeição a Messias por espaço eleitoral e recados a Planalto e STF
item.description: Senate President Davi Alcolumbre engineered the rejection of Jorge Messias' STF nomination, delivering a historic defeat to President Lula and asserting his political authority. The move, driven by dissatisfaction with the federal government, the judiciary, and a strategic shift toward the center-right ahead of 2027, aims to consolidate his power and secure re-election as Senate leader. Allies say it also counters rising opposition influence and reasserts his autonomy after years of alignment with the Lula government.

item.title: Urgência para PLP dos combustíveis requer frieza na relação com o Congresso, apontam integrantes do governo
item.description: The government faces pressure to quickly approve PLP 114/2026, which aims to curb gasoline prices and avoid inflationary impacts, despite the political crisis triggered by the rejection of Jorge Messias’ nomination to the STF. Urgency was approved in the Chamber, but the report by Deputy Marussa Boldrin remains pending, delaying the vote. Despite instability, government officials stress the need for congressional negotiation to avoid electoral damage.

item.title: TSE ressalta não haver previsão legal expressa sobre candidaturas coletivas
item.description: The Superior Electoral Court (TSE) stated there is no express legal provision for collective candidacies in Brazil, emphasizing that all stages of the electoral process are based on individual candidacy. The ruling came in response to a public consultation by federal deputy Kim Kataguiri and councilman Rubens Nunes, seeking clarification on eligibility, campaign finance, gender and race quotas, electoral propaganda, and collective mandates. While rapporteur Minister Isabel Gallotti voted against full consideration of the consultation due to the lack of legal provision, Minister Floriano de Azevedo Marques argued in a dissenting vote that the Electoral Justice can still exercise its advisory competence even without specific regulation.

item.title: Com 7x1 no Senado, aumenta a chance de Lula deixar de concorrer
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva suffered a major defeat in the Senate, with a 7x1 vote under the leadership of Davi Alcolumbre, increasing doubts about his candidacy for re-election in 2026. This parliamentary reversal weakens his political base and raises questions about the viability of a third term.
